title: Step-up (RFC 9470)
lede: A resource server challenges a low-acr token (RFC 9470); the BFF runs a stronger sign-in and retries. Mock acr names.

nodes.label: BFF
sub: Holds the PKCE verifier and the session-token cookie. In this lab the page plays this part.

nodes.label: Mock PingOne
sub: Issues flows, codes and mock tokens. Not a real tenant.

nodes.label: Resource server
sub: Mock. Demands acr mock:multi for a transfer.

nodes.label: Mock phone
sub: Stands in for the user's device (CIBA).

steps.title: Ask for a transfer
steps.what: The user asks for a transfer.

steps.title: The challenge
steps.what: POST /rs/transfer with the low-acr token. The resource server answers 401 and a WWW-Authenticate challenge with acr_values (mock names) and max_age.

steps.title: Open a stronger flow
steps.what: The BFF opens a new pi.flow with the challenge's acr_values and max_age.

steps.title: Password and MFA
steps.what: Password, then device and one-time passcode, because mock:multi was asked for.

steps.title: New token
steps.what: Resume and token exchange. The new token has acr mock:multi and a fresh auth_time.

steps.title: Retry the transfer
steps.what: POST /rs/transfer again with the new token. 200.
